biggest_catch: No platform-wide rate — pay is set per project on official oneforma.com project pages, and the application pipeline is slow (five stages; reported 2+ months to approval), with work availability varying by region.
catches: Pay differs per project — the official project pages state the figure per project (e.g., $37.50 for the 4-video Centaurus Kids project; $18 for a phone-call contributor project). No single platform rate exists.
Five-stage application: job application, surveys, certifications, file signature, recruiter review — reported 2+ months in some cases.
Availability is project- and region-specific; no guaranteed volume.
Twice-monthly pay only after you confirm your invoice (confirm by the 1st for payment around the 10th; by the 15th for around the 25th); $10 minimum balance.
PayPal limited to $300/year; above that Tipalti/wire/bank transfer (Payoneer default).

steps: Go to https://www.oneforma.com/ and create a contributor account.
Complete the platform NDA certification on first login.
Browse the Jobs tab for projects available in your region — each listing states its pay.
Apply for a project; complete any required surveys, skill/language certifications, and file signature.
Wait for recruiter review and approval (can take weeks to months — apply to several projects at once).
Complete the task as specified; confirm your invoice by the 1st or 15th for the twice-monthly payout.
timing: Twice a month after you confirm your invoice — confirm by the 1st for payment around the 10th, by the 15th for around the 25th (third-party-reported cadence; project pages state pay-on-completion).
